purpose: Test how closely current Pando NLD country geometry minus the bundled Natural Earth lake polygons approximates actual dry land.

method.country: Spherical area of current state:NLD:natural-earth-5.1.1 polygon components; European and Caribbean components separated by location.
method.waterMask: Spherical area of every bundled Natural Earth lake feature intersecting the European Netherlands study BBOX 3,50.5,7.3,53.7.
method.officialControl: CBS NBBG2022 land and inland-water areas for Nederland; Caribbean island areas from Rijksoverheid.
method.caveat: Area comparison is a validation of aggregate coverage, not an exact polygon overlay against CBS/BRT water geometry.

cbs2022.note: CBS defines land/water using BRT topographic water surfaces; table is definitive for NBBG2022.

europeanNetherlands.note: The net figure includes cancellation from the generalized IJsselmeer polygon being about 140.7 km2 larger than the CBS IJsselmeer+Markermeer category; it is not a direct polygon-difference measurement.

wholeStateIncludingCaribbeanComponents.note: Caribbean components are not part of the CBS Nederland NBBG2022 area table; official island areas are added separately only for a whole-state sanity check.

conclusion.exactStatement: Current NLD country polygon minus current bundled lake polygons is not an accurate dry-land polygon.
conclusion.broadStatement: It reproduces the broad modern central reclamation pattern reasonably, especially major IJsselmeer/Flevoland land-water structure, but leaves too much inland water classified as land.
conclusion.nextDataNeed: A fuller BRT/TOP10NL or NBBG-derived water polygon mask is needed before treating subtraction as a canonical modern dry-land baseline.
